R3_elapsed_delivery.invariant: Lag is the elapsed age of the oldest unmirrored reply, zero when caught up, and an incident clears only after its recorded oldest reply is mirrored.
R3_elapsed_delivery.cause: The shared comparison subtracted two emission timestamps, while the oversized reader skipped older replies and the cursor retained only the newest timestamp.
affected_occurrences: bin/fm-main-backstop.py:main watermark, lag and incident clearing
axes: first fresh reply after long silence
R3_elapsed_delivery.resolution: Keep deduplicated unmirrored timestamps in the existing byte cursor, compute age from their minimum at the shared comparison, and retain each alarm timestamp until the watermark passes it. Remove tail-only bootstrap and its now-unused prefix adoption helper and constants.
negative_evidence: Whole-file and delta results converge on remote_oldest and one shared main comparison.
Local status notices remain excluded from the ingestion watermark.
Over-budget scans preserve cursor progress and remain unverified until the tail is reached.
Replacement scans preserve pending timestamps until mirrored, so truncation cannot clear an existing incident.
R1 fixture cleanup and R6 draft-safe nudge paths are retained unchanged.
